between.description: Count the days, weeks, months and Monday-to-Friday working days between two dates.

inclusive.description: true when the question counts both dates ('counting both', 'inclusive', 'from … through …'); false to count up to but not including the second

holidays.description: every holiday the question names, YYYY-MM-DD; [] if none

add.description: A date moved forward (or back, with negative numbers) by years, months, weeks, days and then working days. Adding months to a day the target month lacks gives its last day.

business_days.description: Monday-to-Friday days, less the holidays, added last

holidays.description: every holiday the question names, YYYY-MM-DD; [] if none

info.description: A date's weekday, ISO week, day of the year, quarter, days in its month and whether it's a working day.
